title: zoomix
description: A lightweight smooth zoom mod for Minecraft
body:
# Zoomix

A lightweight zoom mod for Minecraft.

## ✨ Features
* **Smooth zoom** — cinematic and seamless camera transition.
* **Customizable zoom level** — adjust it to your liking.
* **Adjustable controls** — bind it to any key you want.
* **Lightweight & Client-side** — works perfectly anywhere and doesn't impact performance.

---

## ⚙️ Configuration
To access the in-game configuration GUI, you will need to install **Mod Menu** and **Cloth Config API**. 
Otherwise, you can still edit the config file manually at `config/zoomix.json`.
